nl.title: 2FA instellen in DirectAdmin
nl.excerpt: Schakel DirectAdmin Two-Step Authentication in, koppel een authenticator-app en bewaar backupcodes.
nl.bodyHtml:
Two-Step Authentication (2FA) vraagt naast je wachtwoord een TOTP-code. Activeer dit op elk DirectAdmin-account waarmee je inlogt.

Stappen

  1. Log in op DirectAdmin.
  2. Open Account Manager → Two-Step Authentication.
  3. Kies TOTP / authenticator-app.
  4. Scan de QR-code met je app.
  5. Bevestig met de eerste code.
  6. Sla scratch/backupcodes veilig op (niet alleen in je mailbox).
  7. Test: uitloggen en opnieuw inloggen met wachtwoord + code.

Tip: Zonder backupcodes kun je jezelf buitensluiten bij telefoonverlies.

Let op: Support vraagt nooit om je 2FA-codes in chat.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: Wachtwoord; niet kunnen inloggen..

en.title: Set up 2FA in DirectAdmin
en.excerpt: Set up 2FA in DirectAdmin: steps in security settings (panel, firewall or CMS) for 2fa, DirectAdmin.
en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers Set up 2FA in DirectAdmin. You work in security settings (panel, firewall or CMS), focusing on 2fa, DirectAdmin — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to security settings (panel, firewall or CMS)
  • Focus of this article: 2fa, DirectAdmin
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Start in security settings (panel, firewall or CMS). Before clicking, note the current value for 2fa, DirectAdmin.
  2. Map the risk around 2fa (ports, accounts, plugins, logs).
  3. Apply the security control (patch, 2FA, firewall, WAF, secret rotation) for DirectAdmin.
  4. Remove or disable what is not needed.
  5. Test legitimate access and that the abuse path is blocked.
  6. Rotate credentials tied to 2fa, DirectAdmin if abuse was possible.
  7. Schedule monitoring or a follow-up check.

Verify

  • Result for 2fa, DirectAdmin matches “Set up 2FA in DirectAdmin”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside 2fa instellen in directadmin
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get 2fa, DirectAdmin right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if 2fa, DirectAdmin touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: security settings (panel, firewall or CMS), backups, tickets.
